en-GB.title: Creative Financing I: Seller Financing Basics
en-GB.summary: Creative Financing I: Seller Financing Basics
en-GB.body: Seller financing replaces or supplements a traditional lender: the seller extends credit to the buyer under privately negotiated terms. Interest, deposit, term, balloon payment, title protection and default remedies interact, so documentation matters. Structures and terminology vary by jurisdiction and require qualified local legal review. The buyer may gain an alternative path to financing; the seller may earn interest but assumes credit and enforcement risk. Level 2 thinking means evaluating the whole structure rather than treating creative financing as a shortcut.
